R.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Josh Green leads by 35.6 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 163,163 votes; a one point swing is about 2,289 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +26.3 and D +44.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Honolulu, a projected net 107,351 votes; Hawaii, a projected net 26,937 votes; Maui, a projected net 21,731 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Josh Green runs furthest behind in Kauai, Hawaii. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 36% of voters, 59 to 41, where a 5 point gain is worth 1.81 points; Immigration voters, 8% of voters, 39 to 61, where a 5 point gain is worth 0.41 points.
The forecast's worst groups for Josh Green: Immigration voters 39 to 61, White voters 59 to 41, 2024 voters who skipped 2022 63 to 37. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.

D.h: What the ballots so far say
D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 0.6 points toward Josh Green. Bank it: chase the remaining mail ballots and low propensity voters who have not voted.
